scope: The two named prime-order maximal-CM curves and their quadratic ray quotient; no ECDLP cost or target extraction claim
statement: For the D=-19 p=47 r=61 control and P-192, the quadratic extension K(sqrt(1-pi)) has relative discriminant (1-pi) of norm r and hence conductor (1-pi); its ray character restricts to the quadratic character of F_r^*/{+-1}. The extension has a quartic defining polynomial over Q, but this does not provide a coordinate-to-root evaluator for an unknown Q=[d]G.
